name: holidaytw
description: npm launcher for the holidaytw Taiwan holiday CLI: downloads the matching native holidaytw binary from GitHub Releases and runs it.

holidaytw.comment: nativeVersion is the native holidaytw GitHub release tag (without the leading 'v') used for downloads. It is intentionally decoupled from the top-level npm 'version' field above so a temporary npm prerelease (e.g. 2.0.0-bootstrap.0) can still resolve and download native release v2.0.0.

author: doggy8088
